rows.question: How far ahead do I need to tell my manager if I want to take 3 days off?
rows.answer: You need to provide at least 6 business days of advance notice for a 3-day absence [1, 3, 4, 5].

rows.question: How many paid sick days do I get, and when do they start?
rows.answer:
Employees are entitled to paid sick leave during each 36-month cycle beginning from their first day of employment [1]. The entitlement equals the number of days typically worked during a 6-week period, which is:
* 30 days of paid sick leave for a 5-day work week [2].
* 36 days of paid sick leave for a 6-day work week [2].

When spread across the three-year cycle, this provides an average of 10-12 paid sick days annually, depending on the work schedule [2]. 

Additionally, another source notes that employees typically receive three weeks of sick leave during the first year, with ongoing payments depending on length of service [4]. (Note: Sources [2] and [4] provide differing details on first-year/cycle amounts).

rows.question: I'm ill today. Can I just log it as PTO instead of sick time?
rows.answer: No, team members are not allowed to substitute PTO for sick time [1]. If you are taking time off for medical needs or sick time (physical or mental-health-related), you must follow the sick time policy [1]. Additionally, all team members must log time away requests—such as Out Sick—in Workday [2].

rows.question: What is the minimum amount of time off the company recommends I take each year?
rows.answer: The company strongly recommends taking at least two consecutive weeks of time off and a minimum of 25 days total throughout the year [1].

rows.question: How long is paid parental leave, and by when does it have to be used?
rows.answer: Paid parental leave is 16 weeks [2, 4]. It must be used prior to the child's first birthday, or the first anniversary of the adoption, foster placement, or birth (for surrogacy) [2].

rows.question: Can I use caregiver sick time to make my parental leave longer?
rows.answer: You may not extend paid parental leave through the use of Paid Caregiver Sick Time, unless you have a family member with a serious health condition [1].

rows.question: What is the most I can spend on a hotel per night on a work trip?
rows.answer:
Hotel stays are reimbursable up to $300 USD (or equivalent local currency) inclusive of tax per night for standard rooms, with a 7-day booking lead time [1]. 

Additionally, Navan uses a "Dynamic Policy" that calculates a fair market price for each search based on travel dates and destinations to accommodate areas where the $300 limit may not apply [1]. Purchases that exceed 20% of the Dynamic Policy will be flagged for manager review [3]. For conference hotel room blocks with better pricing than Navan, the pricing may exceed $300 USD/night, in which case you should contact the AP team for an exception [3].

rows.question: What is the daily meal allowance when I travel for work?
rows.answer: The daily meal allowance while traveling on Company business is reimbursable up to $120 USD (or local equivalent currency) per day [2].

rows.question: I bought something for work four months ago and forgot to claim it. Can I still get reimbursed?
rows.answer: You can still get reimbursed only if your expense claim is approved by your Manager, as claims over 90 days from the purchase date will not be reimbursed otherwise [1], [4].

rows.question: Can I put a $6,000 purchase through Navan as an expense?
rows.answer: No, purchases over $5,000 need to go through the procurement process in Zip rather than being expensed via Navan [1, 3, 4]. Up to $5,000 can be expensed via Navan [1, 2].

rows.question: How much will the company pay towards a co-working space?
rows.answer: The company pays up to $700.00 per month for a monthly co-working space [1, 2], and up to $100.00 per day for daily office passes (limited to 5 one-off days in a calendar month without requiring manager or finance approval) [3]. Only the rent for the space is reimbursable; security deposits, advance payments, travel, parking, meals, beverages, access cards, insurance, and other additional expenses are not covered [4].

rows.question: What is the limit for home internet reimbursement, and is the router covered?

rows.question: Is there a yearly budget for upgrading my home office setup?
rows.answer: Yes, existing team members receive a yearly refresh of 500 USD (or equivalent local currency) to purchase upgrades, replacements, or enhancements to their home office setup [1]. This yearly refresh only applies to team members who have been employed for the entire previous calendar year and excludes laptops [1].

rows.question: Is there a ceiling on the total expenses I can claim in one month?
rows.answer: E-Group members have a maximum monthly reimbursement limit of $20K USD before additional approvals are required [2]. Additionally, monthly co-working space expenses have a limit of $700.00 per month [3]. The sources do not specify a general ceiling for all other employees.

rows.question: If I pay for a $100 monitor partly with a $50 gift card, how much do I get back?
rows.answer: GitLab will reimburse $50, which is the net amount charged to your personal payment method, rather than the pre-discount price of $100 [1].

rows.question: How much can I claim per year for courses and training?
rows.answer: I couldn't find an answer to that in the documents available to you. Try rephrasing, or ask the team that owns this topic.

rows.question: If the company pays for my university course and I resign, do I have to pay it back?
rows.answer: Yes, if you voluntarily terminate employment before completing 12 consecutive months of active employment, academic study or tuition expenses of $1,000 USD and over must be refunded to GitLab [3]. This policy applies to academic study reimbursements only [3].

rows.answer: I couldn't find an answer to that in the documents available to you. Try rephrasing, or ask the team that owns this topic.

rows.question: What is the minimum vacation entitlement for employees in Germany?
rows.answer: Team members in Germany are entitled to at least 20 vacation days [1].

rows.question: For a sales role with $100,000 on-target earnings and a 60/40 split, what is the base salary?
rows.answer: For a sales role with $100,000 on-target earnings and a 60/40 split, the base salary is $60,000 [1].

rows.question: Am I allowed to watch a film on my company laptop?
rows.answer: Yes, you may privately use GitLab property, such as a MacBook, to watch a movie as long as it does not violate the law, harm GitLab, or interfere with Intellectual Property [1].

rows.question: How do I declare a production incident?
rows.answer: It is always preferred to err on the side of choosing a higher severity and declaring an incident for a production issue, even if you are not sure [1]. Reporting high severity bugs via this process engages the appropriate engineering teams [1]. When declaring an incident in Slack, you should provide a short description of what is happening in the "Name" field [1].

rows.question: For which incident severities is the engineer on call paged automatically?
rows.answer: I couldn't find an answer to that in the documents available to you. Try rephrasing, or ask the team that owns this topic.

rows.question: An S3 incident came in on Saturday. Does it have to be mitigated over the weekend?
rows.answer: No. Mitigation for `~severity::3` and `~severity::4` incidents can occur during normal business hours, Monday-Friday [1].

rows.question: What exactly counts as a degraded service?
rows.answer: A `Degraded` service is defined as any sustained 5-minute time period where a service is below its documented Apdex SLO or above its documented error ratio SLO [1].

rows.question: I'm reporting an incident and I'm not sure how bad it is, but many customers seem affected. Which severity do I choose?
rows.answer: If you are unsure about the severity but are seeing a large amount of customer impact, please select S1 or S2 [2]. It is always better to err on the side of choosing a higher severity and declaring an incident for a production issue, even if you are not sure [1].

rows.question: How quickly must an Incident Manager On Call respond to an escalation?
rows.answer: An Incident Manager On Call has a 15-minute SLA to respond to escalations [1].

rows.question: Who is expected to serve on the Incident Manager rotation?
rows.answer:
Incident Manager responsibilities and participation in the rotation are expected of:
- Engineering Management and Staff+ Engineer job families in the Development and Infrastructure departments [1].
- In some cases, Senior Engineers may also participate [1]. 
- Certain team members in the Engineering Group [5].

rows.question: How long should a newly launched service have Tier 2 on-call coverage?
rows.answer: Any new feature or service arriving through the Component Owner Model should have a 24x5 Tier 2 SME for at least the first six months [1].

rows.question: What are the data classification levels?
rows.answer: The data classification levels are green, yellow, orange, and red [3].

rows.question: How is personal data classified, and is anything exempt?
rows.answer:
Personal data is classified as Orange [2]. However, there is an exception for GitLab Team Member names, their work email addresses, and their GitLab usernames, which are classified as Yellow [2]. 

Additionally, the classification of personal data should not change to a level below Orange based on its source, because personal data gathered from public sources is not exempt from protection under certain data protection laws [1].

rows.question: Who do I ask if I can't work out how a piece of data should be classified?
rows.answer: If you cannot identify a data element or are uncertain of its risk, classification, and handling, you should contact the Security Risk team in Slack via @security-risk [1].

rows.question: Can I copy Red data from its approved system into another tool?
rows.answer:
No, Red Data may not be transmitted from an approved Red data source to any other systems or solutions without first obtaining approval from the Privacy and Security teams [1, 2]. 

However, a limited exception exists for team members providing technical support to customers, who are permitted to migrate RED classified customer data to their GitLab-managed laptops solely for the purpose of providing customer support services [4].

rows.question: Who does the on-call security engineer page to escalate a security incident?
rows.answer: The Security Engineer On Call (SEOC) pages the Security Incident Manager On Call (SIMOC) to escalate an incident within GitLab [1].

rows.question: What inherent risk level does a vendor get if it handles Red data?
rows.answer: A vendor gets a Critical inherent risk level if it handles Red data [2].

rows.question: How many vendor bids do I need for a new $150K purchase?
rows.answer: For a new $150K purchase, you need 2-3 vendor bids (business led RFP) [1].

rows.question: How long does the legal review step of a purchase request take?
rows.answer: The legal review step takes 3 to 21 days [5]. Additionally, legal aims to complete the review within 5 business days of submission [2]. These timelines are guidelines and can be extended if additional terms, requirements, or risks are identified [5].

rows.question: Can I buy a software subscription on my own card and expense it?
rows.answer: No, all software purchases charged to personal or corporate credit cards will be denied for reimbursement [3]. Software subscriptions of any kind are not permitted on the Navan Purchasing Card [1]. Instead, you must submit a Purchase Request via Zip for individual software subscriptions, which will be paid via a Navan virtual card after obtaining the necessary approvals [1, 3].

rows.question: Can Accounts Payable pay a supplier by cheque?
rows.answer: No, AP does not issue check payments [2]. Suppliers are to be paid via NetSuite Electronic Payments, ACH, or Wire only [2].

rows.question: An invoice came in above the purchase order amount. How much overage is tolerated?
rows.answer: All invoices are subject to a 10% PO tolerance [1]. Overages up to $1,000 USD (or local currency equivalent) beyond this tolerance will be reviewed by the AP Team and routed to FP&A for approval [1].

rows.question: How far in the future can a quote start date be for an order to be processed?
rows.answer: Orders will be processed as long as the Quote Start Date is within 30 calendar days from the date of submission [2]. If the Quote Start Date is more than 30 days in the future, Order Management will approve and update the close date to the earliest date the opportunity can be booked [1].

rows.question: Which team does Sales Commissions sit in?
rows.answer: Sales Commissions is a part of Field Operations and reports into Sales Operations [1].
